Export contains case metadata, approved artifacts, source references and checksum audit manifests, excluding secrets/internal prompts. Deletion honors holds, writes tombstones, removes blobs/index entries and records receipts; held protected records are retained/receipted. Data-subject access uses the same inventory, not an invented endpoint. Tenant/workspace scope, partial receipts and lineage purge remain open. DAT-015 vault/rotation rules remain binding during retention/exit.
